name: context7_resolve_library
description: Search for a library by name and return its Context7 ID options with trust scores and snippet counts. Call this first when you don't know the exact library ID.

query.description: Optional context query to rank results by relevance

name: context7_get_docs
description: Fetch up-to-date documentation for a library using its Context7 ID (e.g. /vercel/next.js). Returns version-specific docs and code examples.

query.description: The question or topic to get relevant docs for

tokens.description: Max tokens to return (default 5000, up to model context limit)

name: context7_lookup
description: SUPER TOOL: Resolve a library name and fetch its documentation in one call. Accepts library names, shortcut keys (nextjs, react, prisma, etc.), or /org/repo IDs. The fastest way to get current docs.

library_name.description: Library name, shortcut key (nextjs, prisma, clerk, etc.), or /org/repo ID

query.description: What you want to know or do

topic.description: Specific doc section to focus on

name: context7_get_topic_docs
description: Get documentation for a specific topic within any library (e.g. 'hooks' in React, 'middleware' in Next.js).

name: context7_get_api_reference
description: Fetch the API reference section of a library — functions, methods, classes, types, and their signatures.

name: context7_get_code_examples
description: Fetch code examples and usage snippets for a library, optionally filtered by a specific pattern or use case.

query.description: Optional: specific example to find (e.g. 'file upload', 'pagination', 'error handling')

name: context7_get_quickstart
description: Fetch the getting started / quickstart / installation guide for a library.

name: context7_get_configuration_docs
description: Fetch configuration options, settings, and environment variable documentation for a library.

name: context7_get_migration_docs
description: Fetch migration, upgrade, and breaking changes documentation for moving between library versions.

name: context7_get_routing_docs
description: Fetch routing and navigation documentation for a library or framework.

name: context7_get_deployment_docs
description: Fetch deployment, hosting, and production configuration documentation for a library.

name: context7_get_authentication_docs
description: Fetch authentication, sessions, JWT, and OAuth documentation for a library.

name: context7_nextjs_docs
description: Fetch current Next.js documentation. Accepts a query or topic to focus the results (e.g. 'app router', 'server actions', 'middleware', 'image optimization').

query.description: What you want to know (e.g. 'server actions', 'middleware', 'dynamic routes')

name: context7_react_docs
description: Fetch current React documentation. Focus on hooks, components, context, state management, effects, and concurrent features.

name: context7_typescript_docs
description: Fetch TypeScript documentation. Covers types, interfaces, generics, utility types, decorators, tsconfig, and advanced patterns.

name: context7_prisma_docs
description: Fetch current Prisma ORM documentation. Covers schema, migrations, queries, relations, middleware, and Prisma Client.

name: context7_supabase_docs
description: Fetch current Supabase documentation. Covers database, auth, storage, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and realtime.

name: context7_drizzle_docs
description: Fetch current Drizzle ORM documentation. Covers schema definition, queries, migrations, relations, and TypeScript integration.

name: context7_clerk_docs
description: Fetch current Clerk authentication documentation. Covers organizations, users, sessions, webhooks, custom flows, and Next.js integration.

name: context7_stripe_docs
description: Fetch current Stripe documentation. Covers payments, subscriptions, webhooks, Connect, billing portal, and the Node.js SDK.

name: context7_resend_docs
description: Fetch current Resend email documentation. Covers sending emails, React Email templates, webhooks, and audiences.

name: context7_tailwind_docs
description: Fetch current Tailwind CSS documentation. Covers utility classes, responsive design, dark mode, plugins, and configuration.

name: context7_shadcn_docs
description: Fetch current shadcn/ui documentation. Covers component installation, theming, and usage with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS.

name: context7_trpc_docs
description: Fetch current tRPC documentation. Covers routers, procedures, context, middleware, React Query integration, and Next.js setup.

name: context7_zod_docs
description: Fetch current Zod documentation. Covers schema types, validation, transforms, error handling, and TypeScript inference.

name: context7_tanstack_query_docs
description: Fetch current TanStack Query (React Query) documentation. Covers queries, mutations, caching, infinite loading, and Next.js SSR.

name: context7_vercel_docs
description: Fetch current Vercel platform documentation. Covers deployments, domains, environment variables, edge functions, and analytics.

name: context7_neon_docs
description: Fetch current Neon serverless Postgres documentation. Covers branches, connection pooling, the Neon API, and pgvector.

name: context7_upstash_docs
description: Fetch current Upstash documentation. Covers Redis REST API, Vector, Kafka, QStash, and rate limiting.

name: context7_cloudflare_workers_docs
description: Fetch current Cloudflare Workers documentation. Covers Workers, KV, R2, Durable Objects, D1, and the Wrangler CLI.

name: context7_hono_docs
description: Fetch current Hono web framework documentation. Covers routing, middleware, RPC, JSX, and edge runtime deployment.

name: context7_react_hook_form_docs
description: Fetch current React Hook Form documentation. Covers register, Controller, validation, schema integration with Zod, and performance.

name: context7_research_stack
description: SUPER TOOL: Fetch documentation for multiple libraries in parallel — research your whole tech stack in one call.

libraries.description: Array of library names or /org/repo IDs (e.g. ['nextjs','prisma','clerk'])

query.description: Common question to answer across all libraries

name: context7_compare_libraries
description: Fetch documentation for two libraries side by side — compare APIs, approaches, and capabilities.

query.description: The aspect or question to compare

name: context7_get_integration_docs
description: Get documentation about integrating two libraries together (e.g. Next.js + Clerk, Prisma + Supabase).

name: context7_cortiware_stack_docs
description: SUPER TOOL: Fetch documentation for the full Cortiware/YardSync stack (Next.js, Prisma, Clerk, Stripe, Resend, Tailwind, Zod) in one parallel call.

query.description: What you want to know across all stack libraries (default: 'getting started')

name: context7_how_to
description: SUPER TOOL: 'How do I X in library Y?' — resolves the library and fetches the most relevant documentation in one natural-language call.

question.description: What you want to do (e.g. 'set up middleware', 'handle file uploads', 'add authentication')

name: context7_debug_error
description: Fetch documentation relevant to a specific error message — helps find the fix by looking up what the docs say about that error.

error_message.description: The error message or stack trace excerpt

library.description: Library the error is from (name or /org/repo ID)

name: context7_get_best_practices
description: Fetch best practices, patterns, conventions, and performance guidance for a library.

name: context7_smart_query
description: HARDENED: Resolve a library by ID or human name (with internal known-library mapping + search fallback) and fetch documentation through the full sanitization defense layer. Use when you want a single resilient call that handles unknown libraries gracefully.

library_id.description: Context7 library ID (e.g. /vercel/next.js) — preferred when known

library_name.description: Human-readable library name (e.g. 'next.js', 'prisma') — auto-resolved if library_id not provided

query.description: What you want to know — topic, question, or keyword

name: context7_upgrade_impact
description: HARDENED: Fetch migration/breaking-change docs for a version upgrade AND optionally scan local files to find deprecated API usage. Returns docs + per-file usage findings to identify what your code needs to change.

library_name.description: Library name if ID not known (uses known-library mapping)

scan_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths to scan for library usage

name: context7_secure_fetch
description: HARDENED: Explicit sanitize-first doc fetch — runs the full defense layer (prompt-injection scanning, content sanitization). Use when you need a guaranteed-clean response object with defense_layer + sanitized flags.

name: context7_fallback_index
description: HARDENED: When Context7 doesn't know a library, fall back to the npm registry + unpkg TypeScript types to build a usable index. Returns Context7 results (if any) + npm metadata (name, latest version, repo, homepage) + first 3KB of TypeScript types.

query.description: Optional search query if you want Context7 to try first

name: context7_cache_status
description: HARDENED: Inspect or invalidate the Upstash Redis cache used by Context7 doc fetches. action='inspect' checks if a library has cached entries; action='invalidate' deletes all cache entries for a library_id. Returns cache configuration status if no library_id given.

library_id.description: Context7 library ID to inspect or invalidate

action.description: inspect = check cache state · invalidate = clear cached entries (default 'inspect')
